_comment: Tests that already fail on main BEFORE the redesign work. They are tolerated (not fixed here) so CI can still catch NEW failures. Remove an entry when the underlying test is fixed in its own change.

failures.name: edit, reassign, cancel edits times and reassigns
failures.reason: Fails identically on unmodified main (expected '13:00' to be '14:00'). Unrelated to the redesign; intentionally left unchanged.

failures.name: hides the actions shortly before the 5-minute link expires, so a dead link is never offered
failures.reason: Fails on GitHub runners on unmodified main (probe job, run 42790472400); passes locally. Timing-dependent fake-timer test in a frozen file, so it is tolerated here and not edited. Needs the founder's approval to keep; remove when fixed in its own change.
